summary: The Pocket Project is a monthly free creativity workshop hosted at Story Parlor and facilitated solely by Alli Marshall, a certified Inward & Artward creative facilitator. It is drop-in, ticketless programming ('Sunday Sessions are FREE to the public. Come as you are') with no membership, dues, sign-up roster, or dedicated community channel (Facebook group/Meetup/Discord) of its own -- only the facilitator and the Story Parlor venue recur, not a fixed set of attendees.

evidence.note: Listing describes it as 'a monthly dose of inspiration for artists' with prompts and gentle group feedback, aimed at any artist wanting to jump-start work -- no mention of members, dues, or a fixed roster.
Only 3 sparse dates over 3+ months (Mar/May/Jun 2026), consistent with one of Story Parlor's rotating facilitator-led Sunday Sessions rather than a standing club.
Page states 'Sunday Sessions are FREE to the public. Come as you are, and enjoy this offering,' explicitly framing it as open drop-in programming, not membership-based.
The Pocket Project is one of several sessions facilitator Alli Marshall runs at Story Parlor; it is her offering under the venue's program, not an independent artists' group with its own identity.

Search for 'The Pocket Project Alli Marshall Asheville' surfaces only Story Parlor's own calendar and bio pages -- no independent group website, Facebook group, Meetup, or news coverage of a Pocket Project community.
